status: DESIGN REVIEW PROTOTYPE — a derived, edited copy of the D-183 sheet; not a production asset, not an approval, D-183's record unchanged
coordinates: {"guide": [from, to]} = the guide's own curved contour between two named vertices; otherwise sheet px of the 1024x1024 D-183 sheet (= the guide's sheet frame): continuous, pixel i covers [i, i+1), x right, y down. Named points are guide-hair-v1 vertices (the approved targets mapped by the guide transform) and are resolved by the generator from tools/avatar/r3-hair-guide-v1.mjs.
paintingSource: the raw D-183 sheet; every kept pixel is the raw pixel unless an edit below names it

remove.why: the long side locks that hang below the image-left ear: cut along the temple contour (A7-n-side -> A9) and the short lower edge (A9 -> L-lowerOuter), so A9 is the inner lower corner

the hanging side mass below the image-right ear and the wedge that separates the right temple lock from the side hair: cut along A8 -> A8-n-side (lock flank), A8-n-side -> A10 (side-hair inner edge) and A10 -> R-lowerOuter (short lower edge)
remove.drawnTufts: the side-hair inner edge A8-n-side -> A10 is a drawn contour with two small tufts pointing towards the face, (746, 664) and (744, 716) with notches (754, 672) and (755, 725), instead of one straight cut through the painting

remove.why: the raw central lock is longer and wider than the design and hangs over the middle of the image-left brow and the image-left eye: cut along the guide's face-opening contour A7 -> A7-n-face -> A5-n-left -> A5 -> A5-n-right -> A6, so the central lock ends at A5 and the brow middle stays free
remove.offsetWhy: the A7 -> A7-n-face flank is pulled into the hair by a ramp from 0 at the A7 tip to 1.6 sheet px at A7-n-face, so its upper, anti-aliased edge stays off the brow middle after placement while the lower part keeps covering the brow's outer end

add.why: the V-shaped parting: hair painted UNDER the raw sheet above two straight edges that meet at A4, so the face opening's highest point is one apex; the raw tuft and notches above the edges stay visible on top
the short lower edge of the image-right side hair reaches the A10 corner: hair painted UNDER the raw sheet between the raw bottom and the edge A10 -> R-lowerOuter

parameters.inkRule: a drawn contour is inked only where the final hair alpha >= 16 (it never creates hair); coverage = clamp(halfWidth + 0.5 - distance, 0, 1)
parameters.compositing: final = (raw with alpha * (1 - removeCoverage)) OVER (add paint with alpha = addCoverage); then ink mixed into RGB by its coverage; alpha unchanged by ink
